image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat resting inside a rocky burrow entrance. The animal's head is clearly visible in the foreground, facing slightly downward and to the right, showing its broad blunt shape, small eyes, rounded ears, and large bare nose. The body is stocky and barrel-shaped, filling the dark cavity behind the head. Visible fur is coarse, thick, and greyish-brown. Surrounding rocks are textured, grey, and form a natural archway over the animal.
